summary: Robin Energy Ltd., a Nasdaq-listed Cyprus shipowner, filed a Form 6-K attaching a November 2, 2026 press release announcing a one-time special cash dividend of $0.10 per common share. Terms: record date November 16, 2026; payment on or about November 20, 2026; 48,243,450 shares outstanding as of October 30, 2026. Nasdaq advised the shares will trade with due bills from the record date through the November 20 payment date, with an ex-dividend date of November 23, 2026, because the dividend exceeds 25% of the trading price. The board declared the dividend; no advisor named. What to watch: due-bill settlement mechanics and the small-cap distribution yield.
